title: Custom Anterior Surfacing of Scleral Lens for Vision Quality Improvement in Patients With Keratoconus
brief_summary: The goal of the study is to examine the effects of custom front-surface wavefront correction on visual performance, and on neutralization of higher order aberrations, in patients wearing a scleral lens device. The investigators will study patients with keratoconus, the most common type of corneal ectasia, who have already been fitted with the BostonSight BSS (Boston Sight Scleral) for improved visual function.
